supersededFreezes.reason: The first formal sweep run (r16-formal-1) exposed a real deterministic defect on the formal path: the controller-authoring candidate advance cleared the frozen policy, the Planner launch compiled a non-provisional policy at the same execution revision, and the first wave-semantics bind failed EXECUTION_POLICY_RECOMPILE_REQUIRED. The freeze was re-cut after the repair.

The delegated re-run (r16-delegated-2) exposed the provider-flaky candidate-drift replacement barrier: a completed handoff acknowledgment whose turn never reported completion failed the rotation. Repaired with the barrier prompt, a 120 s bounded readiness timeout, and a single bounded retry with a fresh session (mirroring initial supervisor materialization). The stale governedOperationBootstrap fixture (report-less FAILED run) was also corrected to the AEH-V2-0118 terminal-error contract.

The formal re-run (r16-formal-3) exposed a real multi-wave defect: the OpenCode inline Serena projection resolved a relative `--project .` against the controller cwd, so every isolated wave worktree shared one pool entry and a completed implementer's writer lease blocked the next wave (SerenaPoolOwnershipError). Repaired by keying the Serena pool by the actual launch root; a same-root concurrent-writer conflict still fails closed.

frozenSourceRule: No src/** edit is permitted during the P0-B sweep. Docs/evidence writes during lane windows are tracked-doc edits recorded by each lane's postRunTrackedDocEditWindow. If any source edit lands, every row whose executed path includes the changed module must be re-run on a newly frozen source (stated rule).
invalidationRuleApplied: The final freeze differs from the first freeze in src/core/run.ts (wave-planning failure observability), src/operations/supervisor.ts (rotation handoff readiness barrier), src/operations/change.ts (provisional bootstrap policy after the authoring advance) and the extracted src/operations/bootstrapPolicy.ts. Every row whose executed path includes those modules is re-run on the final freeze: change-delegated, change/direct-change, audit, formal-sdd, certification 4, cancel/recovery, issue-driven/authority. No row keeps superseded-freeze evidence.

additionalRepairsAfterFirstFreeze.resolution: The controller-authoring candidate advance re-establishes the provisional bootstrap policy for the advanced candidate (bindBootstrapOperationPolicy extracted to src/operations/bootstrapPolicy.ts), so the first execution-semantics bind advances the operation execution revision and clears the policy instead of failing EXECUTION_POLICY_RECOMPILE_REQUIRED at wave planning.
regressions: tests/formalAuthoringCandidateAdvance.test.ts (provisional policy + wave-semantics bind at the advanced revision)

additionalRepairsAfterFirstFreeze.resolution: The candidate-drift rotation handoff prompt is an explicit session-readiness barrier that does not invite file reads or commands; the durable checkpoint remains continuity authority for later consolidation turns. The rotation previously exceeded the 60 s initialization barrier while the model inspected the checkpoint.

runTask persists the owning wave-planning rejection reason on the planning stage and a harness.plan.failed event instead of a bare FAILED stage; this is how the EXECUTION_POLICY_RECOMPILE_REQUIRED cause was captured durably (docs/evidence/s13/round16-interrupted-attempt.json).
regressions: exercised by the interrupted diagnostic attempt and every re-run lane
